title: Weighted Gaussian quadrant integral
statement: Let $0<\rho<1$ and $t\in\mathbb R$. For the density of a centered bivariate standard normal pair with correlation $\rho$, the iterated integral over $z_1>t$ and $z_2>t$ of $(z_2-\rho z_1)(z_1-\rho t)$ times that density equals $\frac{(1-\rho^2)^{3/2}}{2\pi}\exp\!\left(-\frac{t^2}{1+\rho}\right)$.
